statuses.label: New home screen
statuses.means: The released app cleans up the TV and puts the new home screen on.

statuses.label: Next test build
statuses.means: Works in our test builds; coming to everyone in a later release once testers confirm it on your brand.

statuses.label: Coming soon
statuses.means: Being worked on for the version shown; until then the app does the clean-up.

statuses.label: Clean-up only
statuses.means: The app switches the clutter off and keeps the TV's own home screen, for the reason shown.

statuses.label: Not possible
statuses.means: This TV does not allow another home screen, so the clean-up is all the app can do.

cleanups.list: Cleans up the TV with its tested list
cleanups.brand: Cleans up the TV with the {brand} clean-up, only the switches known to be safe on {brand} TVs
cleanups.general: Cleans up the TV with the general clean-up, only the switches known to be safe on any TV

homes.new: and puts the new home screen on.
homes.test: and keeps the TV's own home screen for now; the new home screen works on it in our test builds.
homes.soon: and keeps the TV's own home screen for now.
homes.cleanup: and keeps the TV's own home screen.
homes.no: and keeps the TV's own home screen.

BOOT_LOOP.why: On this TV family the setup wizard comes back at every restart, and with the TV's own home screen off the TV can fail to start.
BOOT_LOOP.short: its setup wizard returns at every restart.
BOOT_LOOP.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

CASTING.why: On this Google device the switch needs the setup wizard off, and casting from phones then stops after every restart.
CASTING.short: casting would stop after a restart.
CASTING.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

FIRE_OS.why: Fire OS keeps Amazon's home screen, so the app does the clean-up only.
FIRE_OS.short: Fire OS keeps Amazon's home screen.

HOME_CHANGED.why: Home already opens a home screen app that was installed on the TV, and the app keeps that choice.
HOME_CHANGED.short: another home screen app is the default.
HOME_CHANGED.change: Make the TV's own home screen the default again, then run Setup again.

OLD_ANDROID.why: The new home screen needs Android 8 or newer, so on this Android the app does the clean-up only.
OLD_ANDROID.short: the new home screen needs Android 8 or newer.

OTHER_HOME.why: Another home screen app also answers the Home button on this TV, so the switch is left alone.
OTHER_HOME.short: another home screen app answers Home.
OTHER_HOME.change: Switch the other home screen app off or remove it, then run Setup again.

PATCHWALL_FEEDS.why: PatchWall is on while Mi TV+ or its web content is off, and with the TV's own home screen off that can stop the TV starting.
PATCHWALL_FEEDS.short: PatchWall is on while its feeds are off.
PATCHWALL_FEEDS.change: Switch PatchWall off, or those apps back on, then run Setup again.

REMOTE_BUTTONS.why: The remote's app buttons only work through the TV's own home screen.
REMOTE_BUTTONS.short: the remote's app buttons need it.
REMOTE_BUTTONS.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

TCL_CN.why: TCL's China firmware does not allow another home screen, so the app does the clean-up only.
TCL_CN.short: TCL's China firmware allows no other home.

TEST_R0.why: The switch with the setup wizard left on works in our test builds for every brand; a release gives it to a brand once its testers confirm the new home screen stays after a restart.

TV_REFUSES.why: This TV refuses other home screens, so the app does the clean-up only.
TV_REFUSES.short: this TV refuses other home screens.

UNKNOWN_HOME.why: The TV's home screen is one the app does not know yet, so it is left alone.
UNKNOWN_HOME.change: A report from this TV helps the app learn its home screen: in the app, Manage, then Help add this TV.

VENDOR_HOME.why: A system service on this TV also answers the Home button, so the home screen is left alone.
VENDOR_HOME.short: a system service also answers Home.
VENDOR_HOME.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

WIZARD_STAYS_ON.why: The TV's setup wizard stays on and could take over the Home button once the TV's own home screen is off.
WIZARD_STAYS_ON.short: its setup wizard could take over Home.
WIZARD_STAYS_ON.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

WIZARD_WIFI.why: The TV's setup wizard saved its Wi-Fi, so the wizard has to stay on, and switching the home screen with it on can crash the TV.
WIZARD_WIFI.short: its setup wizard saved the Wi-Fi.
WIZARD_WIFI.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

WIZARD_WIFI_UNKNOWN.why: The TV could not say who saved its Wi-Fi, so its setup wizard has to stay on, and switching the home screen with it on can crash the TV.
WIZARD_WIFI_UNKNOWN.short: it could not say who saved the Wi-Fi.
WIZARD_WIFI_UNKNOWN.change: The Home button helper, in the 0.4.8-beta2 test build, leaves the TV's own home screen on and still opens the new one when you press Home.

coming_soon.title: XGIMI MoGo 3 Pro
coming_soon.what: The switch works, but the projector's remote keys turn Google TV's home screen back on. The Home button helper keeps Home on the new home screen.

coming_soon.title: Chromecast with Google TV and the Google TV Streamer
coming_soon.what: The Home button helper: Google TV and its setup wizard stay on underneath, so casting keeps working, and Home opens the new home screen.

coming_soon.title: RockTek Google TV boxes
coming_soon.what: The Home button helper, which keeps the setup wizard on, so casting keeps working too.

coming_soon.title: Google TV sets that keep their home screen because of the setup wizard
coming_soon.what: The Home button helper: the TV's own home screen and its setup wizard stay on, and pressing Home takes you to the new home screen.
